blocks.text: 一時風 駛一時船 一咧人 一款的命運
blocks.spelling: tsi̍t sî hong sái tsi̍t sî tsûn tsi̍t leh lâng tsi̍t khuán ê miā-ūn

blocks.text: 我可比 海上的帆船 要去叼位 無人關心無人問
blocks.spelling: guá khó-pí hái-siōng ê phâng-tsûn beh khì tó-uī bô-lâng kuan-sim bô-lâng mn̄g

blocks.text: 窗外 風雨 冷酸酸 尚驚耽誤心愛妳 的青春
blocks.spelling: thang-guā hong-hōo líng sng sng siōng kiann tam-gōo sim-ài lí ê tshing-tshun

blocks.text: 人講三年一運 好歹照輪 認真打拼的人 一定會出運
blocks.spelling: lâng kóng sann nî tsi̍t ūn hònn pháinn tsiàu-lûn līn-tsin phah-piànn ê lâng it-tīng ē tshut-ūn

blocks.text: 拼出運哪拼出運 想著前途半暝嘸敢睏
blocks.spelling: piànn tshut-ūn a̍h piànn tshut-ūn siūnn-tio̍h tsiân-tôo puànn-mî m̄ kánn khùn

blocks.text: 拼出運哪拼出運 嘸驚離離落落的命運
blocks.spelling: piànn tshut-ūn a̍h piànn tshut-ūn m̄ kiann lī-lī-lak-lak ê miā-ūn
